title: Messages and notices
instr: Read the messages and notices and answer the questions.
paras: Hi Long, the dentist called. Your appointment isn't on Tuesday now. It's on Wednesday, at the same time. They're closed on Tuesday. Mum
COMPUTER CLASS: Bring your own laptop if you have one. If not, you can use one of ours, but please book it a day before.
BAKERY: Birthday cakes need two days. Order by phone or in the shop. We can write a name on the cake for free.
BEACH CLEAN-UP: Saturday 7 to 9 am. Water and bags are free. Please bring your own gloves.
Thu, I can't find my keys. I think I left them in your bag at the cinema. Can you check and text me? I'm at home until 6. Kien

items.q: What has changed about the appointment?

ev.s: It's on Wednesday, at the same time.

items.why: Lịch hẹn chuyển sang thứ Tư, cùng giờ.

wrong.A: Chỉ ngày đổi, giờ vẫn như cũ.

items.q: What should students without a laptop do?

opts.t: book a computer the day before

ev.s: please book it a day before

items.why: Không có máy thì đặt mượn máy trước một ngày.

wrong.A: Thông báo không nhắc máy tính bảng.
wrong.B: Thông báo không nói đến sớm.

items.q: What does the bakery say?

opts.t: You must order a birthday cake two days before.
You can only order cakes in the shop.
Writing a name on a cake costs extra.

ev.s: Birthday cakes need two days.

items.why: Bánh sinh nhật cần đặt trước hai ngày.

wrong.B: Có thể đặt qua điện thoại.

items.q: What must people bring to the beach clean-up?

ev.s: Please bring your own gloves.

items.why: Phải tự mang găng tay.

items.q: What does Kien want Thu to do?

opts.t: look for his keys in her bag
bring his keys to his house

ev.s: Can you check and text me?

items.why: Kiên nhờ Thu xem trong túi có chìa khoá không.

wrong.A: Kiên nghĩ chìa khoá ở trong túi của Thu, không ở rạp.
wrong.C: Kiên chỉ nhờ kiểm tra rồi nhắn tin.

title: Life on the river
instr: Read the text and answer the questions.
paras: My grandfather, Mr Sau, has lived on a boat on the Mekong River for fifty years. People often think he is a fisherman, but he isn't. He sells fruit to people in other boats at the floating market. He starts work at four in the morning, because the market finishes before nine.

Last year his children asked him to move into a house in the town. He stayed there for two weeks, but he didn't sleep well because of the motorbikes. "Everyone thinks I missed the river," he laughs, "but I just missed sleeping!" Now he is back on his boat, and my uncle visits him every Sunday.

items.q: What is Mr Sau's job?

ev.s: He sells fruit to people in other boats

items.why: Ông bán trái cây ở chợ nổi.

wrong.B: Nhiều người nghĩ ông là ngư dân nhưng không phải.
wrong.C: Bài không nói ông chở khách du lịch.

items.q: Why does he start work so early?

opts.t: He likes to finish before his family wakes up.
It is cooler in the morning.

ev.s: because the market finishes before nine

items.why: Chợ kết thúc trước chín giờ.

items.q: Why didn't Mr Sau like the house?

opts.t: He missed the sound of the river.

ev.s: he didn't sleep well because of the motorbikes

items.why: Xe máy ồn khiến ông ngủ không được.

wrong.C: Mọi người nghĩ vậy, nhưng ông nói chỉ nhớ giấc ngủ.

items.q: How long did he live in the house?

ev.s: He stayed there for two weeks

items.why: Ông ở nhà hai tuần.

wrong.B: Năm ngoái là lúc các con đề nghị.

title: Street food in Hanoi
instr: Choose the right word for each gap.
paras: Hanoi is famous (1) ___ its street food. Many visitors (2) ___ that the best food is in restaurants, but most people in the city eat on small plastic chairs by the road.

My favourite dish is bun cha. I usually eat it at a small place near my office. The food there is very good, (3) ___ it is always busy at lunchtime. It (4) ___ about two dollars. If you visit Hanoi, you (5) ___ try it!

items.q: Gap 1

ev.s: Hanoi is famous (1) ___ its street food.

items.why: "famous for" = nổi tiếng vì.

wrong.B: "famous with" dùng cho người biết đến (famous with tourists), không cho lý do.

items.q: Gap 2

ev.s: Many visitors (2) ___ that the best food is in restaurants

items.why: "Many visitors think…" = nhiều khách nghĩ (mà thật ra không đúng).

wrong.B: "know" là biết chắc; câu sau cho thấy điều đó sai.
wrong.C: "say to" cần người nghe (say to me).

items.q: Gap 3

ev.s: The food there is very good, (3) ___ it is always busy at lunchtime.

items.why: Đồ ăn ngon NÊN luôn đông: "so" chỉ kết quả.

wrong.B: "because" đảo ngược quan hệ: đông không phải lý do đồ ăn ngon.
wrong.C: "or" chỉ sự lựa chọn, không nối nguyên nhân với kết quả.

items.q: Gap 4

ev.s: It (4) ___ about two dollars.

items.why: "It costs + giá" = có giá.

wrong.A: "spend" có chủ ngữ là người tiêu tiền.
wrong.B: "pay" có chủ ngữ là người trả.

items.q: Gap 5

ev.s: you (5) ___ try it!

items.why: "you should try it" = bạn nên thử.

title: Four short conversations
instr: Listen and answer the questions. You will hear each conversation once.

script.t: Did you go to the gallery on Saturday?
We wanted to, but it was full. So we went to the new bookshop instead. Next week we'll try the gallery again.
The listening was easy, and the writing was OK. But the reading was really hard. I didn't finish it.
Excuse me, does this bus go to the hospital?
Not this one. Take the number 6. It stops in front of the main door. The 16 goes to the stadium.
Shall we meet at the cafe at three?
I've got a lesson until three. Let's say half past three, at the bookshop next to the cafe.

items.q: Where did the man go on Saturday?

ev.s: So we went to the new bookshop instead.

items.why: Phòng tranh kín chỗ nên họ đi hiệu sách mới.

wrong.A: Phòng tranh kín chỗ; tuần sau mới thử lại.
wrong.C: Sân vận động là chuyện xe buýt số 6.

items.q: Which part of the exam was difficult for Phong?

ev.s: But the reading was really hard.

items.why: Phần đọc rất khó, Phong làm không kịp.

items.q: Which bus goes to the hospital?

ev.s: Take the number 6.

items.why: Xe số 6 dừng trước cửa chính bệnh viện.

wrong.A: Xe này không đi bệnh viện.
wrong.B: Xe số 16 đi sân vận động.

items.q: Where will they meet?

ev.s: at the bookshop next to the cafe

items.why: Hẹn ở hiệu sách cạnh quán cà phê.

wrong.B: Cô bé có lớp học đến ba giờ, không hẹn ở đó.
wrong.C: Quán cà phê là đề nghị đầu tiên.

title: Booking a homestay
instr: Listen to the phone call and answer the questions.

script.t: Hello. I'd like a room for three people for two nights, from Friday.
We've got a room with a garden view for forty dollars a night, or a small room for thirty.
The small one is fine. Is breakfast included?
Yes, it is. And we can cook dinner too, but you need to tell us by four o'clock.
Great. We're coming by motorbike. Can we leave it there?
Yes, in front of the house. Please don't leave it in the garden.

items.q: How many nights will the man stay?

ev.s: for two nights, from Friday

items.why: Ông đặt hai đêm từ thứ Sáu.

items.q: How much will the room cost each night?

ev.s: The small one is fine.

items.why: Ông chọn phòng nhỏ giá ba mươi đô.

wrong.B: Bốn mươi đô là phòng nhìn ra vườn.

items.q: What must guests do if they want dinner?

ev.s: you need to tell us by four o'clock

items.why: Phải báo trước bốn giờ chiều.

wrong.A: Hạn là bốn giờ, không phải sáu giờ.
wrong.C: Chỉ cần báo trước, không nói trả tiền trước.

items.q: Where can the man leave his motorbike?

ev.s: Yes, in front of the house.

items.why: Để xe trước nhà.

wrong.A: Không ai nói để sau nhà.
wrong.B: Chủ nhà dặn đừng để trong vườn.
